slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck. Turn 4 asked about warehouse-to-port shipment capacity limits, which is a different constraint, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary did not mark any truck-capacity assumption for confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There are no truck capacity limits / no other capacity limits that affect the transportation plan.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the maximum number of containers a truck can carry; it only confirmed that there are no warehouse-to-port route capacity limits and then concluded there are no other capacity limits.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2, which does not affect the core feasible set or optimal cost. All P0/P1-level modeling facts were addressed before READY_TO_MODEL, so stopping was appropriate despite missing the P2 truck-capacity detail.

summary: The agent clarified demand fulfillment, integrality, cost structure, and warehouse-to-port capacity, but missed the hidden truck capacity limit. Overall stopping was appropriate because the missed slot is only P2 and does not change the core optimization problem.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
